newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Arafat arrives in Morocco after U.S. summit.
newsitem.headline: Arafat arrives in Morocco after U.S. summit.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Morocco on Thursday to brief King Hassan on the Middle East summit in Washington termed a failure by advisers to Arafat's Palestinian Authority.
"I can make no comment until I have seen King Hassan," said Arafat at the airport.
The Palestinian leader, who appeared relaxed and spoke for 10 minutes with Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, was expected to meet the king later in the morning and then leave for Paris.

Arafat arrived aboard a Saudi airliner after the summit involving Arafat, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Jordan's King Hussein and U.S. President Bill Clinton, ended on Wednesday night with few concrete results other than an agreement to resume low-level Israeli-Palestinian talks.
"There were no positive results due to the Israeli position of refusing to deal seriously with basic issues," said Yasser Abed Rabbo, an adviser to the Palestinian Authority.
